verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a general rule engine for event-triggered automation in Datadog, such as monitors firing actions or workflow automation on events. The closest item is a code-coverage quality gate that blocks merges at configurable thresholds. That is a narrow, related feature rather than user-defined event-to-action rules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
